keywords.name: Vulnerable
keywords.text: Takes 50% more damage.

keywords.name: Weak
keywords.text: Deals 25% less attack damage.

keywords.name: Frail
keywords.text: Gains 25% less Block.

keywords.name: Poison
keywords.text: At turn end lose HP equal to Poison, then Poison falls by 1.

keywords.name: Bleed
keywords.text: At turn end lose HP equal to Bleed. Ignores Block.

keywords.name: Burn
keywords.text: At turn end take Fire damage equal to Burn, then Burn falls by 1.

keywords.name: Frozen
keywords.text: Cannot play the first card each turn (enemies skip their next move).

keywords.name: Stun
keywords.text: Skips its next turn.

keywords.name: Fear
keywords.text: Cannot attack; moves are lost.

keywords.name: Silence
keywords.text: Cannot play Spell cards or cast.

keywords.name: Strength
keywords.text: Attacks deal additional damage per stack.

keywords.name: Dexterity
keywords.text: Block gains are increased per stack.

keywords.name: Thorns
keywords.text: Attackers take damage per stack.

keywords.name: Stealth
keywords.text: Enemies cannot target you; your next attack deals bonus damage.

keywords.name: Shield
keywords.text: Absorbs damage, persists between turns.

keywords.name: Regen
keywords.text: At turn end heal HP equal to Regen, then Regen falls by 1.

keywords.name: Disease
keywords.text: At turn end lose HP equal to Disease and max HP is reduced for the combat.

keywords.name: Curse
keywords.text: Increases damage taken from your next hits by its stacks; cleared when it triggers.

keywords.name: Enrage
keywords.text: Deals bonus damage per stack; gains stacks when hurt.

keywords.name: Armor
keywords.text: Reduces each hit of damage by the stack count.

keywords.name: Taunted
keywords.text: Must target the taunter.

keywords.name: Marked
keywords.text: Takes extra damage from the next attack.

keywords.name: Frostbite
keywords.text: Takes Frost damage per stack at turn end; stacks of 5 Freeze.

keywords.name: Cold
keywords.text: Chills: reduces damage dealt; reaching 3 stacks applies Frozen.

keywords.name: Corrupted
keywords.text: Healing received is reduced.

keywords.name: Madness
keywords.text: At 5 stacks take shadow damage and discard a card.

keywords.name: Sleep
keywords.text: Cannot act until damaged.

keywords.name: Feral
keywords.text: In a feral form: attacks are boosted.

keywords.name: Intangible
keywords.text: All damage and HP loss is reduced to 1.

keywords.name: Metallicize
keywords.text: At turn end gain Block equal to stacks.

keywords.name: Ritual
keywords.text: At turn start gain Strength equal to stacks.

keywords.name: Rage Generation
keywords.text: Gain extra Rage whenever you deal or take damage.

keywords.name: Energized
keywords.text: Gain bonus Energy at the next turn start.

keywords.name: Vampiric Embrace
keywords.text: Heals you for a share of the damage you deal.

keywords.name: Soul Link
keywords.text: Damage you take is shared with your demon.

keywords.name: Amplify Curse
keywords.text: Your next curse has doubled stacks.

keywords.name: Delayed
keywords.text: When this expires, a stored effect triggers.

keywords.name: Rockbiter Weapon
keywords.text: Your attacks deal +2 damage.

keywords.name: Flametongue Weapon
keywords.text: Your attacks burn the target.

keywords.name: Flametongue Weapon II
keywords.text: Your attacks burn the target harder.

keywords.name: Frostbrand Weapon
keywords.text: Your attacks apply Weak.

keywords.name: Frostbrand Weapon II
keywords.text: Your attacks apply stronger Weak.

keywords.name: Windfury Weapon
keywords.text: Imbue lasts the whole combat. Your first attack each turn strikes twice.

keywords.name: Windfury Weapon II
keywords.text: Imbue lasts the whole combat. Your first attack each turn strikes twice, hitting harder.

keywords.name: Spell Power
keywords.text: Your spells deal bonus damage.

keywords.name: Reincarnation
keywords.text: If you would die, return with a portion of your health.

keywords.name: Free Cast
keywords.text: Your next cards cost 0.

keywords.name: Retain Block
keywords.text: Your Block does not expire.

keywords.name: Fire Resistance
keywords.text: Reduces fire damage taken.

keywords.name: Frost Resistance
keywords.text: Reduces frost damage taken.

keywords.name: Nature Resistance
keywords.text: Reduces nature damage taken.

keywords.name: Veiled
keywords.text: Enemy intents are hidden. Holy cards remove it.
